newsitem.title: CANADA: ELAN Energy adopts poison pill.
newsitem.headline: ELAN Energy adopts poison pill.

text.p: ELAN Energy Inc, which has been speculated to be a takeover target, said on Tuesday its board adopted a shareholder rights plan.

ELAN, with extensive heavy oil operations in Alberta and Saskatchewan, said the plan was intended to provide the company more time to evaluate any takeover bid and enable it to search out alternative transactions.
The company, whose share price has fallen since last autumn, said it was unaware of any pending takeover bid.

Under the plan, rights are triggered if a party acquires more than 20 percent of ELAN's common shares. Rights would not be triggered by a "permitted bid" made to all shareholders by way of a takeover bid circular.
A permitted bid must meet certain other conditions, including an acceptance period at least 45 days, the company said.
The plan was subject to shareholder and regulatory approval, the company said.
